title: Sonam Wangchuk loses muscle mass on Day 17 of hunger strike; Mahua Moitra, Arundhati Roy urge him to end fast
description: However, Wangchuk, 59, refused to call off the hunger strike and instead questioned the Centre's unwillingness to engage in talks. Dipke quoted Wangchuk as saying 'Don't ask me to end my fast. Ask the govt why they won't even have a dialogue.'
